About me

I believe design is more than looks. I work closely with founders, product managers and developers to build products users enjoy and businesses can scale. Expect clear communication, attention to detail and on-time delivery.

Design principles I follow: modern, premium visuals; scalable design systems; responsive, mobile-first layouts; and accessibility based on WCAG.
